comments.author: Guilder
comments.body:
Available from the New World Premium Bottle (released 9/30). Stats:

+1 Reloading
+1 Gunfire
+1 Caution
500 fame to equip; no gender/job class restrictions

Would've also been a selectable reward item from the Reminiscence Trunk if GAMA hadn't passed over the pre-2nd Age update event "1st Age Memorial", but so it goes.

Source: wiki.ogplanet.com/uwo/index.php?title=New_World_Premium_Bottle
Images: rabbilog.blog46.fc2.com/blog-entry-209.html (towards the bottom of the page)
